## Spec File
`.specs/012-responsive-qa.md`

## Objective
Test the Nexify website across all device/browser/OS combinations and fix every breakpoint failure found.

## Test Matrix

### Desktop
- 1920×1080 (Windows/Linux Chrome, Firefox)
- 1366×768 (Windows Chrome/Edge)
- 1440×900 (macOS Safari/Chrome)

### Mobile
- 390×844 — iPhone 15 (Safari iOS)
- 375×667 — iPhone SE (Safari iOS)
- 412×915 — Pixel 7 (Android Chrome)
- 360×800 — Galaxy (Android Chrome)

### Tablet
- 820×1180 portrait (iPad Safari)
- 1180×820 landscape (iPad Safari)
- 768×1024 portrait (tablet generic)
- 1024×768 landscape (tablet generic)

## Required Breakpoints
- ≤375px (small mobile)
- 376–767px (mobile)
- 768–1023px (tablet)
- 1024–1439px (small desktop)
- ≥1440px (large desktop)

## Items to Validate
- No horizontal scrollbar on ANY viewport
- Body text ≥14px, CTA text ≥16px
- Tap targets ≥44×44px on touch
- Images use `object-fit: cover/contain` — no distortion
- Sticky header doesn't overlap content
- iOS input zoom fix: all inputs have `font-size: 16px`
- Form fields usable on mobile

## Deliverable
For each failing combo:
- Viewport dimensions + browser
- Playwright screenshot
- Affected element (CSS selector)
- Root cause
- Applied CSS fix in `css/responsive.css`

## Acceptance Criteria
- Zero horizontal scrollbars at any tested viewport
- All breakpoints render correctly
- Lighthouse Mobile score ≥90
